title: Chart quiz #7
caption:
Chart quiz #7. Lock in your answers before the reveal.

Q1: Which way will it break?
Q2: Bounce or break?
Q3: Where does the take-profit go?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #BollingerBands #SupportAndResistance #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Squeezes, support and targets. Question one. The Bollinger Bands have squeezed tight. Which way will it break: up, down, or can't tell? Trick question. You couldn't tell. A squeeze says a bigger move is coming, but not which way. This time it broke down. Wait for the break, then decide. Question two. Price is testing support for the third time. Bounce, or break? It broke. Each pullback was shallower, and volume picked up on the push. But no level breaks every time. Question three. You bought near the bottom of the range. Where does your take-profit go? A, B, or C? A, just below the old resistance. C cuts a good trade short, and B sits beyond a level that's turned price away before, so it may never fill. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
